release_notes:
FocusDefend v1.8.1 Production Release — AI Digital Wellbeing & Permission Protection:
• Production Optimized: R8 ProGuard minification & resource shrinking applied (reduced package size from 48.5MB to 31.4MB).
• Mandatory Login Permission Gate: Fixed glitch where users could log in without granting necessary system permissions. Users are seamlessly guided through the dedicated Permissions Setup Screen.
• Real-Time Permission Sync: Lifecycle-aware permission tracking dynamically activates core shields (Usage Access, Display Over Other Apps, Focus Notifications) when returning from Android Settings.
• AI Digital Wellbeing Intelligence: Local-first device-usage tracking, mathematical pattern detection (Recreational Surges, Study Leakage, Sleep Curfew Alerts, Focus Streaks), and LLaMA-powered supportive habit coaching.
• Strict Privacy Guard: Zero message contents, keystrokes, passwords, or personal chats collected. Aggregations happen entirely on-device.
• Seamless Background OTA Auto-Update: FocusForegroundService checks and delivers updates silently without disrupting active sessions.
